description: NAPLAN results is an interactive resource (dashboard, viewer or map) listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Regional Data Hub group, published by Australian Curriculum, Assessment and Reporting Authority (ACARA). NAPLAN test results provide information on how students are performing in literacy and numeracy and support improvements in teaching and learning. The data from NAPLAN test results gives schools and systems the ability to measure their students’ achievements against national minimum standards and student performance in other states and territories. Coverage is Australia; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as annual, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2023-08-15. Files and pages listed: Report (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. The subject is social or economic context with only a loose link to infrastructure. It gives regional context for capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
